title: Causal scenario feedback and surrogate management under coculture model mismatch
status: Local freeze after declared development; not public preregistration

design.interpretation: Four independently assigned IC/target blocks per mathematical family; not biological replicates

primary_comparisons: scenario_managed vs scenario_feedback: computation and achieved quality
endpoints: actual composition and physical feasibility; all cases in denominator
jointly feasible paired biomass/time; complete totals also reported

domain_bound.note: No uptake upper bound (0.5*23+100*1.3)/1.8=78.6112; effective≤98.264; finite noise margin verified in audit

inference: Descriptive paired/cluster-resampling across fixed mathematical conditions only; no biological reliability confidence statement
timing: Main effectiveness campaign: 4 isolated processes, wall times diagnostic only. Separate prespecified serial panel after workers exit; rotated method order, one BLAS thread; shared compiled initialization separately recorded.
failure_policy: Failed candidates logged; managed verification failure triggers matched direct fallback; whole controller exception applies zero feed with explicit flag
limitations: Finite scenarios do not cover all model errors
Future policy composition observations ideal in design
Analytic family is designed, not a calibrated second organism
